articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $82,000 as Nasdaq rebounds more than 1%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin treasury company Strive continued to add large numbers of BTC to its balance sheet, while far larger peer Strategy acquired only a small amount.

articles.title: Bitcoin whale moves $34 million in BTC it got in 2013 when coins traded at $131
articles.snippet: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved 411 BTC, now worth about $34 million. It is one of several long-dormant wallets to wake up recently.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
articles.snippet: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

articles.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
articles.snippet: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

articles.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
articles.snippet: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.
